content.short: Blowfish is a risk-assessment tool for Web3 wallets.
content.description: Blowfish relies on a robust, built-in machine learning algorithm to monitor wallet activity and identify fraudulent possibilities whenever a user’s wallet interacts with platforms that appear suspicious. By offering this protection, developers can help shield their end users from hacks and related losses that result from malicious activity. Blowfish runs across Polygon, Ethereum, and Solana, delivering cross-chain coverage across three major blockchains to support safer, more trustworthy interactions for users as they transact online.
